book.name: Mɑɑku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Yesu u yinɑnɑɑn ɡɑri mɔ̀
Yen biru Yesu doonɑ min di u dɑ Yudeɑn temɔ kɑ Yuudɛnin ɡuruɔ. Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ kpɑm mɛnnɑ win mi. Nɡe mɛ win dɔɔnɛ u kpɑm bu Gusunɔn ɡɑrin keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ.
Fɑlisi ɡɑbɑ nɑ win mi bu kɑ win lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri. Bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, woodɑ yɑ koo wurɑ tɔnu u win kurɔ yinɑ?
U bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, woodɑ yerɑ̀ Mɔwisi u bɛɛ wɛ̃.
Bɑ nɛɛ, u nɛɛwɑ durɔ u yinɑnɑɑn tireru yore kpɑ u de win kurɔ u doonɑ.
Mɑ Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn woo bɔbunun sɔ̃nɑ Mɔwisi u bɛɛ woodɑ ye yoruɑ.
Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Gusunɔ u hɑnduniɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ u tɔmbu tɑkɑ kuɑwɑ durɔ kɑ kurɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ durɔ u koo win tundo kɑ win mɛro deri kpɑ wi kɑ win kurɔ bɑ n mɑninɛ,
kpɑ be yiru kpuro bu ko wɑsi tee. Nɡe mɛyɑ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔmbu yiru mɑ n kun mɔ tɔn turo.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, tɔnu u ku mɑɑ kɑrɑnɑ ye Gusunɔ u mɛnnɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ wurɑ yɛnuɔ, bɑ nùn ɡɑri yin tubusiɑnu bikiɑ.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑɑwure wi u win kurɔ yinɑ mɑ u kpɑo suɑ, u sɑkɑrɑru kuɑwɑ.
Kurɔ ɡoo ù n mɑɑ win durɔ yinɑ mɑ u kpɑo suɑ, sɑkɑrɑrɑ u kuɑ.
Yesu u bibu kɑnɑru kuɑ
Yerɑ tɔmbɑ kɑ bibu nɑ win mi u kɑ bu bɑbɑ. Adɑmɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ bu ɡerusi.
Ye Yesu wɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ u mɔru bɑrɑ, mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i bibu derio bu nɑ nɛn mi, i ku bu yinɑri, domi Gusunɔ u bɑndu swĩi tɔmbun sɔ̃ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe bibu.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑɑwure wi u kun bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi wure nɡe mɛ bii yɑ̃kɑbu ɡɑ rɑ ɡen mɔwɔbu wure, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u n sɑ̃ɑ bɑn teɡii.
Yerɑ u bibu suɑ, u ben bɑɑwure nɔmɑ sɔndi, mɑ u bu domɑru kuɑ.
Gobiɡii ɡoon ɡɑri
N wee, ye Yesu u kpɑm swɑɑ wɔri u doonɔ, durɔ ɡoo dukɑ dɑ win mi u yiirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔn ɡeo, mbɑ kon ko n kɑ wɑ̃ɑru te tɑ ku rɑ kpe wɑ.
Mɑ Yesu nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ mɑn sokumɔ tɔn ɡeo. Goo sɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ ɡeo, mɑ n kun Gusunɔ turo.
N ǹ ɑ woodɑ yɛ̃ rò ye yɑ ɡerumɔ, “I ku tɔnu ɡo. I ku sɑkɑrɑru ko. I ku ɡbɛni. I ku ɡoo ɡɑri mɑni. I ku ɡoo tɑki di. I bɛɛn tundo kɑ mɛro bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛyɔ.”
Mɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, woodɑ yeni kpurowɑ nɑ swĩi nɛn birun di.
Yerɑ Yesu u nùn mɛɛrɑ u nùn kĩɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, ɡɑ̃ɑ teenɑ nu nun tie. A doo ɑ dɔrɑ kpuro ye ɑ mɔ kpɑ ɑ yen ɡobi sɑ̃ɑrobu bɔnu kuɑ. À n kuɑ mɛ, kɑɑ n dukiɑ mɔ Gusunɔn mi. Yen biru kpɑ ɑ nɑ ɑ mɑn swĩi.
Adɑmɑ u mɔruɑ ɡɑri yinin sɔ̃, mɑ u doonɑ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu domi dukiɑ bɑkɑɡiiwɑ.
Yesu u yɑm mɛɛrɑ u kɑ sikerenɑ, mɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n sɛ̃ ɡem ɡem dukiɑɡii u kɑ bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi wurɑ.
Mɑ biti bɑkɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be mwɑ win ɡɑri yin sɑɑbu. Yesu u kpɑm nɛɛ, bɔrɔbɑ, n sɛ̃ ɡem ɡem be bɑ ben nɑɑnɛ doke dukiɑ sɔɔ bu kɑ bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi wurɑ.
Yen sɛ̃sɔ ɡɑ kpɑ̃ n kere yooyoo ɡu du yɑburɑn wɛ̃rɔ ɡu yɑri.
Bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ biti soorɑ mɑ bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, wɑrɑ koo den fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Yesu bu mɛɛrɑ tii, mɑ u nɛɛ, tɔmbun miyɑ yɑ ǹ koorɔ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔn mi yɑ koo koorɑ, domi Gusunɔ u ku rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu kpɑnɛ.
Mɑ Piɛɛ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n wee, sɑ kpuro deri sɑ nun swĩi.

Yesu nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɡoo ù n win kpɑɑru deri nɛn sɔ̃ kɑ Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑn sɔ̃, ǹ kun mɛ win mɑɑbu kɑ win wɔnɔbu kɑ win sesubu, ǹ kun mɛ win mɛro kɑ win tundo, ǹ kun mɛ win bibu, ǹ kun mɛ win ɡbeɑ,
u koo kpɑm kpɑɑnu wɑ wunɔm wunɔm tɛ̃ sɑɑ yeni sɔɔ. U koo dinu wɑ, kɑ mɑɑbu kɑ wɔnɔbu kɑ sesubu kɑ mɛrobu kɑ bibu kɑ ɡbeɑ, kɑ mɑɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru. Siɑ u koo mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑru te tɑ ku rɑ kpe wɑ.
Adɑmɑ tɔn dɑbinu be bɑ tɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ ɡbiikobu bɑ koo rɑ ko dɑ̃ɑkobu, be bɑ mɑɑ tɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑkobu, bɑ koo rɑ ko ɡbiikobu.
Yesu u win ɡɔɔ kɑ win seebun ɡɑri mɔ̀ nɔn itɑse
Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu ɡbiiye bɑ swɑɑ mɔ̀ bɑ dɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Biti win bwɑ̃ɑbu mɔ̀, mɑ be bɑ bu swĩi bɑ nɑnde. Mɑ Yesu kpɑm ɡɛrɑ bee tiɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru ye, u bu sɔ̃ɔbu wɔri ye n koo nùn deemɑ.
U nɛɛ, n wee, sɑ Yerusɑlɛmu dɔɔ mi bɑ koo Tɔnun Bii yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu nɔmu sɔndiɑ. Bɑ koo nùn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ bu kɑ nùn ɡo, kpɑ bu nùn tɔn tukobu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Beyɑ bɑ koo nùn yɑɑkoru ko, bu nùn yɑ̃ɑtɑm sie, bu nùn sɛni so. Yen biru kpɑ bu nùn ɡo. Sɔ̃ɔ itɑse kpɑ u se ɡɔrin di.
Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnun bikiɑbu
Yerɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnu, Sebeden bibu, bɑ susi Yesun bɔkuɔ mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni sɑ kĩ ɑ sun kuɑ ye sɑ ko nun bikiɑ.
Mɑ u bu bikiɑ, mbɑ i kĩ n bɛɛ kuɑ.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ de su sinɑ, turo wunɛn nɔm ɡeuɔ turo mɑɑ wunɛn nɔm dwɑrɔ, wunɛn yiiko sɔɔ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, i ǹ yɛ̃ ye i bikiɑmɔ. I ko kpĩ i wɑhɑlɑ sɔbe ye kon sɔbe? I ko bɑtɛmu ye kpĩ yèn bweseru bɑ koo mɑn ko?
Bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ko kpĩ. Mɑ Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡeemɑ, i ko wɑhɑlɑ wɑ ye kon wɑ, bɑ koo mɑɑ nɛn bɑtɛmun bweseru bɛɛ ko,
ɑdɑmɑ n ǹ nɛn bɑɑ n kɑ ɡɔsi be bɑ koo sinɑ nɛn nɔm ɡeuɔ kɑ nɛn nɔm dwɑrɔ. Tɔn bèn sɔ̃ ɑye ni, nu sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ, beyɑ bɑ koo nu wɑ.
Ye bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔku te tɑ tie tɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ, tɑ kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnu mɔru kuɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u bu sokɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn tii i yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ be tɔn tukobɑ rɑ ɡɑrisi ben tem yɛ̃robu, bɑ rɑ n bu dɑm dɔremɔ kpɑ ben wiruɡibu bɑ n bu tɑɑre.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ sɑ̃ɑ mɛ bɛɛn mi. Bɛɛn ɡoo ù n kĩ u ko wiruɡii bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ, u koowo bɛɛn sɔmɔ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ bɛɛn wi u kĩ u ko ɡbiikoo, u koowo bɛɛ kpuron yoo.
Domi bɑɑ Tɔnun Bii, u ǹ nɛ bu kɑ nùn sɑ̃, u nɑwɑ u kɑ ɡɑbu sɑ̃, kpɑ u ɡbi u kɑ tɔn dɑbinu yɑkiɑ.
Yesu u Bɑɑtimɛ wɔ̃ko wi bɛkiɑ
Yerɑ bɑ Yeriko duɑ. Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u yɑriɔ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu kɑ tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ sɑnnu, bɑrɑ kowo wɔ̃ko ɡoo wi bɑ rɑ soku Bɑɑtimɛ, Timɛn bii, u sɔ̃ swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ.
Ye u nuɑ mɑ Yesu Nɑsɑrɛtiɡiiwɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u mɔ̀, Yesu, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu, ɑ nɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo.
Mɑ tɔn dɑbirɑ nùn ɡerusimɔ, bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔmɔ u mɑrio. Adɑmɑ u ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ too too u mɔ̀, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu, ɑ nɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo.
Yesu yɔ̃rɑ, mɑ u nɛɛ bu nùn sokumɑ. Bɑ wɔ̃ko wi sokɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u ku mwiɑ kpɑnɑ, u seewo, Yesu u nùn soku.
Wɔ̃ko wi, u win ɡɔ̃ɡɔ kɑkiɑ u kɔ̃ u seewɑ fuuku, mɑ u nɑ Yesun mi.
Mɑ Yesu u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ kĩ n nun kuɑ. Mɑ wɔ̃ko wi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yinni nɑ kĩ n yɑm wɑwɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo, wunɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu nun bɛkiɑ. Mii mii u yɑm wɑ, mɑ u Yesu swĩi swɑɑ yen min di.
